server.name: community-memorix
server.note: Launched the way its registry entry says to (packageArguments: serve). It keeps its store in ~/.memorix, so HOME moves into the trial root and only the npm download cache points back at the real home.

observer.name: memorix-store
observer.note: revisionCount is ignored deliberately. With topicKey set the server does what its schema promises (the existing observation is updated, not duplicated), and the only difference between one application and two is that this counter reads 2. Observing it made the fixture score DUPLICATED, which would have been a false finding: the stored payload is identical. Ignoring it makes one application indistinguishable from two, which is the honest verdict, and the fixture is then kept out of the duplicate denominator rather than counted as safe.
